actionType.title: Action Type
actionType.description: One of: Recommendation, Decision, Human_Response, Query, Validation, Calculation, Create, Update, Data_Change, Escalation, Tool_Call, Delete, Error. Pick the type that best matches the step.

agentId.title: Agent Id
agentId.description: Use the same Agent Id used to start the session.

inputContext.title: Input Context
inputContext.description: Summarize what the agent evaluated for this step — the inputs, fields, or data considered.

outputResult.title: Output Result
outputResult.description: State what the agent produced, decided, or returned for this step.

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Explain in plain language why the agent took this step. This is shown directly in the audit trail.

sessionId.title: Session Id
sessionId.description: Optional. Leave blank: your open AgentLedger run is used, or a new one is started.

relatedRecordId.title: Related Record Id
relatedRecordId.description: Optional. The record this step is about, used to find or start the run.

policyReference.title: Policy Reference
policyReference.description: Optional. The policy or rule this step applied, for example "Escalation Policy v3, rule 2".
